newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil to raise sugarcane, hydrous alcohol prices.
newsitem.headline: Brazil to raise sugarcane, hydrous alcohol prices.

text.p: Brazilian sugar-cane and hydrous alcohol prices are to rise by 8.37 percent from May 21, a Finance Ministry official said.
"Finance Minister Pedro Malan has signed the document and it should be published shortly," the official said.
According to business daily Gazeta Mercantil, the last price adjustment was in April 1996.
The official said the government is still working towards totally liberalising the market in May 1998 after officially opening up the anhydrous alcohol sector on May 1 this year.
However exports may be opened up earlier depending on the findings of a working group to be formed which will look at removing export quotas.
